content: Nuvemshop/Tiendanube API v1 GET /products returns each product with a categories[] array of full category objects: {id, name: {es,en,pt}, description: {es,en,pt}, handle: {es,en,pt}, parent, subcategories, google_shopping_category, created_at, updated_at}. Same {pt,...} multilingual pattern already used for product.name/handle in ingest-catalog.js. A product can have multiple categories (array), but per D-26 the Talgui catalog has exactly 1 category per product today.
